reference_basis.instruction: Preserve anatomical identity and characteristic hair baseline; exclude office wardrobe, jewellery, background, posture, and polished studio lighting.

face_geometry.description: Soft slender oval face with moderate length, gently defined high-mid cheekbones, a smooth narrowing jaw, and a small rounded-to-subtly-pointed chin. Delicate but not childlike.

eyes.description: Dark brown elongated almond eyes, average spacing, clear tapered inner and outer corners, subtle upper-lid fold, and level-to-slightly lifted orientation. Preserve natural East Asian eyelid anatomy without enlarging into round eyes.

brows.description: Dark brown medium-full brows with a low gentle arch, clean tapered ends, and natural separation from the eyes.

nose.description: Straight slim-to-medium bridge, compact softly rounded tip, and narrow natural nostril width; moderate projection in balance with the delicate jaw.

mouth.description: Medium-width mouth with smooth medium-full lips, subtle cupid's bow, and slightly fuller lower lip. Corners lift gently in a composed smile.

skin.description: Light warm-neutral skin with even but realistic natural texture and gentle tonal variation; retain a small beauty mark below the left eye when visible.

hair.description: Very dark espresso-brown long hair, thick and glossy with loose natural S-wave through the lengths, center-to-soft-off-centre part, airy curtain fringe and wispy face-framing strands. Preserve colour, length, and density while allowing styling variation.

body_proportions.description: Medium-tall lean softly athletic frame with graceful upright carriage, gently defined shoulders, long balanced legs, a defined waist, and naturally feminine hips; toned without appearing frail or heavily muscular.

identity_relationships.facial_length_to_width: slender oval, moderately longer than wide
identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: subtle cheek prominence flows into a smooth narrow jaw
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: slim compact nose over a moderately wider composed mouth
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: upper and lower lips balanced, lower lip slightly fuller
identity_relationships.feature_balance: elongated eyes, slim nose, gentle jaw, and airy dark hair create a refined harmonious identity

expression_behavior.neutral: Composed approachable expression with relaxed lips and attentive level gaze.
expression_behavior.smile: Small controlled smile lifts the corners and softly rounds the cheeks without dramatically changing face width.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Cheeks lift subtly and remain gently defined rather than full.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Eyes narrow delicately at the outer corners while preserving their elongated almond geometry.

signature_features.feature: long thick espresso-brown hair with airy curtain fringe
soft slender oval face and small chin
small beauty mark below the left eye

mutable_features.hair_style: limited: arrangement may change; preserve long length, dark base colour, density, and soft face framing

negative_identity_constraints: no exaggerated anime-like East Asian features
